The first release of MT2Config, the `config.exe` settings dialog of the Metin2 client.

## Download

**config.exe** is the only file players need. Put it into the client folder, next to the client executable and
`metin2.cfg`.

## Highlights

- **Client-compatible `metin2.cfg`:** read and written with the same rules as the client's
  `CPythonSystem::LoadConfig()` / `SaveConfig()`.
  - The file is never deleted.
  - Keys the tool does not edit (`SAVE_ID`, `BPP`, custom keys) are kept.
  - Numbers are written in the client's format on every Windows language.
- **Real display modes** of the monitor, with the refresh rate limited to the 60 Hz the client supports.
- **13 languages:** English, Turkish, Danish, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Hungarian, Dutch, Portuguese,
  Romanian, Greek and Russian, selectable in the window.
- **Tooltips** that explain every option.
- **Dark mode**, switchable at once (dark title bar on Windows 10 1809+ and 11).
- **Save and Play** starts the client right after saving.
- **Options the client does not apply** (gamma, view distance, object culling, uncompressed textures) are hidden, and
  their lines in `metin2.cfg` are left untouched.

## Requirements

- Windows 7 SP1, 8.1, 10 or 11.
- .NET Framework 4.8. It is built into Windows 10 (1903+) and 11; on older versions it usually comes through Windows
  Update, otherwise from [Microsoft's installer](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet-framework/net48).
